features.text: Black moulded composite body and cams
Two teardrop cams, round at the back, pointed toward the load
Raked teeth along each cam's inner flank
Stainless Phillips pan-head screws through the axles
Low rounded base, a flat bridge between the cams
Gap between the cams takes a 4-10 mm line
No fairlead hoop or anything sticking out past the base

budget.note: hero is a Nanite part; build_kit makes the light copy at a quarter of the triangles
